name: AECi — Worker error rate > 1% (5m)
message:
Combined SSR + API Worker 5xx error rate has exceeded 1% over the last 5 minutes. This is a user-facing reliability signal.

First checks: recent deploy (GET /api/version), Datadog error logs (service:aeci-api OR service:aeci-web status:error), Cloudflare Workers dashboard.

Runbook: https://github.com/the-wbs-project/aec-integrations/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOKS.md#high-worker-error-rate
